name: Drawer
purpose: A side panel for details or secondary forms.
description: Panel from right, left or bottom (mobile sheet); content is a slot.
alternative: Drawer, Slideout menu and Command menu are Figma-only. For a focused task use `Modal`; for a short action list use `DropdownMenu`.

do: Use for detail views and secondary forms.
Use the Bottom position on mobile.
Put content into the Content slot.
forbidden: Never use a drawer for critical confirmations — use Modal.
Never make a drawer wider than half the screen.
